prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original square gouache postcard illustration for a polished cozy Unity VR fishing game's paper journal. Create an exquisitely art-directed hand-painted tiny island bay: a cream lighthouse with a small coral-orange roof on a sandy sage-green island, a charming little wooden fishing cottage, a timber jetty, a small orange and deep-green fishing boat in the turquoise foreground, two graceful seagulls and quiet curling wave strokes. The island sits a little above center, broad calm sea below, warm cream sky above. Storybook gouache, Japanese coastal travel sketchbook, confident irregular brush contours, restrained fine pencil accents and subtle real paper grain, layered flat color shapes with a few brush flecks. Warm, playful, serene, lovingly crafted independent-game illustration; beautifully balanced compact silhouette readable inside a VR interface. Palette cream #F4E4C3, sand #D2A76E, sage #6D9F89, deep sea #314F48, coral #EF916B, muted aquamarine sea. Matte paint, soft warm afternoon light, crisp broad forms and very intentional details. Full bleed square image, all lighthouse/boat subjects safely within central 85%, no frame. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI widgets, photorealism, glossy 3D, gradients or blurred haze. This is finished game art, not a mockup.
